five_steps.reason: AE-PD implies AE-PSD, and the existing integrable PSD-mean theorem supplies Hermiticity. The text explicitly withholds strictness until the next step. Tropp2.13 is non-strict background, not falsely attributed as a strict-PD proof.

For fixed nonzero x, the real quadratic functional is finite-dimensional continuous linear, hence integrable and commutes with the mean. AE positivity plus probability/nonzero mass rules out zero scalar integral; Hermiticity completes PD. No uniform lower bound is assumed, and empty indices are valid.

Literal product law, row/angle/tensor/cutoff/mean definitions and all four sums are retained. Existing canonical Structure and Radius calls use hq, not new premises. Triangle, |cos|≤1 and global-sign norm1 give the actual dR* cap; finite sums give measurability and Hermiticity.

CFC identifies the scalar exp(sx) functional calculus with actual matrix-algebra exp(sS), proves pointwise PD and uniform norm cap, then continuity/measurability and the probability bound yield Bochner integrability. P is applied to the actual G and μ. No uniform lower-envelope route is asserted.

Continuous linear trace commutes with the integrable mean and yields integrable scalar trace; the canonical trace envelope plus r² cardinality and dR* radius gives the cap, and actual MX PD on the nonempty carrier gives strict trace positivity. No matrix log, independence-based MGF estimate or Bernstein theorem is emitted.
